attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 (AlmaLinux 9.6) into a 3-node RabbitMQ 3.13.7 cluster (Erlang 26.2.5 from EPEL; RabbitMQ installed from the official GitHub release RPM after the vendor cloudsmith setup scripts 404'd). Created the "payments" vhost and an "app_user" account with full configure/write/read permissions scoped to that vhost. Verified a durable quorum queue "orders" (replicated on all 3 nodes) survives loss of a node: published a persistent message, rebooted the leader node (node1), and successfully consumed the message from surviving node2 while quorum (2/3) was preserved. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time OS reboot of all three nodes, proving each node's boot_id changed and that RabbitMQ cluster membership, quorum-queue replication, and the app account fully recovered after each restart, ending with a final live publish/consume check on node2.
